extDescription.message: Warns before you paste ID numbers, credit cards, phone numbers or API keys and offers a masked version; detects pastejacking.

paste_aria.description: Accessible name of the paste prompt.

paste_title.message: ClipGuard: what you are pasting contains secrets

copy_aria.description: Accessible name of the pastejacking warning.

copy_title_replaced.message: ClipGuard: this page changed what you copied

copy_title_unselected.message: ClipGuard: this page wrote suspicious content to the clipboard

copy_advice.message: Don't paste it into a terminal, Win+R or the File Explorer address bar yet.

copy_write_failed.message: Couldn't write to the clipboard. Please copy again.

pj_hidden.message: Contains invisible characters (zero-width or bidi control)

pj_added.description: SIGNAL is one of the pj_sig_* messages.

pj_newline.message: Adds a line break, so pasting it into a terminal runs it immediately

pj_replaced.message: What was written to the clipboard differs from the text you selected

pj_sig_cmd.message: calls cmd to run a command

pj_sig_pipe_shell.message: pipes a download straight into a shell

pj_sig_lolbin.message: calls a commonly abused system program

rule_sk_api_key.description: Rule labels by rule id (rules/*.json, "-" becomes "_"); same text as RuleLabel_* in CoreStrings.resx.
